content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the vilnius regional district court the court has made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property the immovable property and credit agreement will be awarded to the applicant while the movable property specifically an audi a4 vehicle will be awarded to the defendant the court has also declared that after the annulment of the marriage the credit agreement remains a joint obligation between the applicant and the defendant the court has ordered the defendant to pay the stamp duty and court fees the court has upheld the action in full annulled the marriage registration and divided the property between the parties the applicant will receive the audi a4 as their sole property and the defendant will receive the volvo s80 as their sole property the court has also ordered the defendant to pay the state budget for the stamp duty and the costs of serving procedural documents
